label: provisional internal assessment
weights_note: These are the repository assessment maxima for the eight spec criteria; the organizers have not published criterion weights. This is not an independent organizer/judge result.

last_independent_assessment.status: preserved historical independent score; before P3c integration

basis.gate_status: incomplete; no allow; locally available six recordings and set O match, three ride and fifteen set F straight rows are missing

criteria.name: Works
criteria.attribution: Inherited P3c detector changes, not P4
criteria.reason: All eight in-envelope set O objects now receive at least one STOP, compared with six in the scored head. Sustained evidence remains weak: #4 2/83, #6 6/125, and #8 22/124 visible frames; the outside #7 has six false STOP frames. Set O is previously inspected and raw-bag replay differs from the 5 mm int16 cache.

criteria.name: Range
criteria.reason: The organizer set O yields only one STOP frame beyond 100 m; no real positive obstacle supports long-range recall, and set F could not be rerun without the ride cache.

criteria.name: Speed
criteria.reason: Native kernels remain enabled, but P4 did not conduct a stand or controlled timing reevaluation; historical latency evidence remains the basis.

criteria.name: Generalisation
criteria.reason: The six recordings provide 5 Hz and ±3 degree mount checks and start-offset sensitivity, but all were already available routes, the ride is absent, and synthetic positives do not establish material robustness.

criteria.name: Technical quality
criteria.attribution: P4 reproducibility and evidence only; no detector improvement
criteria.reason: All six original caches are integrity-checked; run manifests, a false-alarm inventory, exact candidate decisions and raw/cache sensitivity are recorded. The full gate and ride-dependent tests cannot complete here.

criteria.name: Ease of launch
criteria.reason: The existing offline image and CI evidence are unchanged; P4 did not conduct a new independent stand or operator rehearsal.

criteria.name: Team approach
criteria.attribution: P4 preregistered tests, transparent rejections and limitations
criteria.reason: The bounded A/B/C hypotheses and rejected short-signature relaxation are documented with results; A/B remain unaccepted because required ride, set F and candidate-specific robustness comparisons could not be completed.

criteria.name: Pitch
criteria.reason: No refreshed independent pitch, deck review or rehearsal was part of this data pass.

limitations: The available data include repeated frames of the same objects and approaches; they are not independent samples.
Anchored placement is not surveyed ground truth.
The ride contains no real obstacles.
The six original raw bag/cache comparison is sensitive to int16 5 mm quantization: set O scores differ (cache 355 inside STOP frames, 6 outside, 3 background; raw 357, 7, 1).
A higher total is a provisional internal judgment only; it does not claim that P4 improved the detector or that unseen real-world generalisation increased.
